text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, adenosine is not on the FDA drug shortage list. Corvale East holds 806 units across three presentations at 45.5 units per day for 18 days on hand. Corvale General holds 605 units across two presentations at 31.8 units per day for 19 days on hand. Corvale Lakeside holds 96 units at 4.5 units per day for 21 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA records show no shortage listing for adenosine as of 2026-10-21. The HealthFirst label (NDC 51662145003) identifies HF Acquisition Co LLC as a U.S. relabeler with FEI 3014534, last inspected VAI on 2025-06-26. The Gland Pharma label (NDC 68083015610) identifies Gland Pharma Limited as an India manufacturer with FEI 3002647489, last inspected VAI on 2024-07-25.

Our position: Current inventory supports 18 to 21 days of supply across sites. No FDA shortage exists. Alternative suppliers are available but not yet qualified for purchase.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate and qualify Eugia US LLC for purchase; requires P&T committee approval.
2. Buyer to evaluate and qualify Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC for purchase; requires P&T committee approval.
3. Buyer to evaluate and qualify Gland Pharma Limited for purchase; requires P&T committee approval.
4. Buyer to evaluate and qualify Henry Schein, Inc. for purchase; requires P&T committee approval.
5. Buyer to evaluate and qualify Heritage Pharmaceuticals Inc. d/b/a Avet Pharmaceuticals Inc. for purchase; requires P&T committee approval.

Not recommended: No allocation changes or clinical protocol adjustments at this time.
